mappings.note: Fauna as the animals of an area is a defining term for the living world. Not LO-46, because nothing is contrasted.
Species found exclusively in one area being endemic is a category of organism. Not LO-58, because no protection is involved.
Naming illegal killing poaching is terminology for a threat that conservation law addresses. Not LO-49, because the item names the act rather than tracing its effects.
Deciding which species is absent from the Red List applies the threat categories. Not LO-58, because the list records rather than protects.
Reserves and laws as measures that increase protection is an organised conservation effort. Not LO-49, because a remedy rather than a cause is the subject.
Finding the correctly matched pair of conservation terms requires telling the categories apart. Not LO-47, because the item tests a pairing rather than one definition.
The main reason species become endangered is cause identification. Not LO-47, because the threat category is given rather than defined.
Desertification as fertile land turning to desert names the end of a causal chain from deforestation. Duplicate in substance of the earlier item.
An interbreeding population being a species is the basic unit of classification. Not LO-46, because nothing is contrasted.
Re-establishing forest on cleared land, reforestation, is an effort to repair the environment. Not LO-49, because it is a remedy rather than a cause.
Biodiversity as the variety of animals, plants and microbes is a defining term. Duplicate in substance of the earlier biodiversity item.
Excluding the non-consequence of deforestation tests the causal chain. Not LO-58, because effects rather than remedies are at issue.
Species found exclusively in one area being endemic is a category of organism. Duplicate of the endemic items.
Animals protected in their natural habitat being a sanctuary distinguishes protected-area types by function. Grouped with the other protected-area definitions.
Animal life of a region being fauna is a defining term. Duplicate in substance of the fauna items.
Birds travelling long distances being migratory is a category of organism defined by behaviour. Not LO-49, because no cause is traced.
The act aimed at preserving India's natural forests is a legal conservation measure. Grouped with the other laws and programmes.
Animals dwindling towards extinction being endangered is a threat category. Grouped with the other status terms.
Excluding the gas that does not cause global warming tests the causal link between gases and warming. Not LO-47, because the item turns on the effect rather than a class of organism.
Excessive fossil fuel burning leading to warming is a phenomenon traced to its cause. Not LO-58, because no remedy is proposed.
Excluding the non-effect of global warming tests the consequences of the phenomenon. Grouped with the other causal items.
Habitat destruction, soil erosion and flooding from deforestation are its consequences. Grouped with the other deforestation-consequence items.
An interbreeding population being a species is the basic unit of classification. Duplicate of the species item.
What the Red Data Book records is the scheme that classifies species by threat. Not LO-58, because it records rather than protects.
Who publishes the Red Data Book belongs with that classification scheme. Kept with the Red Data Book item rather than the conservation-programme items, since the book is a record of categories.
Planting new trees to restore destroyed forest, reforestation, is an effort to repair the environment. Duplicate in substance of the earlier reforestation item.
Excluding what deforestation does not cause tests the causal chain. Grouped with the other consequence items.

Banning trade in orang-utans and turtles so they survive appeals to concern for life, the value LO-60 names. Not LO-58, because the item asks for the reason to care rather than for the measure itself.
Sorting species into endangered and vulnerable applies the threat categories. Not LO-46, because organisms are placed in classes rather than two categories contrasted.
Identifying the extinct flightless bird of Madagascar applies the extinct category. Not LO-49, because hunting is given rather than asked for.
A species at risk of extinction being endangered is a threat category. Duplicate in substance of the endangered items.
The biosphere as the sphere supporting life is a defining term. Duplicate of the biosphere items.
Naming forest clearing deforestation is environmental-hazard terminology. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter.
What deforestation leads to is a phenomenon traced to its cause. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
The gas plants need for photosynthesis is part of explaining that process. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
Naming photosynthesis as the food-making process is a process explanation. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
Rising carbon dioxide causing warming relates a phenomenon to its cause. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
Reduced rainfall causing drought is a causal chain. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
Loss of topsoil leading to erosion is a causal chain. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
The biosphere as the sphere supporting life is a defining term. Exact duplicate of an earlier item.
